summary: Computes the determinant of a 4x4 matrix of floats using cofactor (Laplace) expansion along column 0. Reads all 16 elements as a flat array a1[0..15] (column-major per the leading name), computes six 2x2 sub-determinants over the trailing 3x3 block, combines them into four 3x3 cofactor minors, and returns the signed dot product with the first column. Pure read-only function, no calls, no branches, no globals.

operations.description: v2 = a1[10]*a1[15] - a1[14]*a1[11]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x28, 0x3C, 0x38, 0x2C
v3 = a1[15]*a1[9] - a1[13]*a1[11]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x3C, 0x24, 0x34, 0x2C
v4 = a1[14]*a1[9] - a1[10]*a1[13]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x38, 0x24, 0x28, 0x34
v5 = a1[8]*a1[15] - a1[12]*a1[11]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x20, 0x3C, 0x30, 0x2C
v6 = a1[14]*a1[8] - a1[12]*a1[10]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x38, 0x20, 0x30, 0x28
v8 = a1[8]*a1[13] - a1[12]*a1[9]; 2x2 minor over elements at offsets 0x20, 0x34, 0x30, 0x24
cofactor term d0 = v2*a1[5] - v3*a1[6] + v4*a1[7]; 3x3 minor for a1[0] using elements at offsets 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C
cofactor term d1 = v2*a1[4] - v5*a1[6] + v6*a1[7]; 3x3 minor for a1[1] using elements at offsets 0x10, 0x18, 0x1C
cofactor term d2 = v3*a1[4] - v5*a1[5] + v8*a1[7]; 3x3 minor for a1[2] using elements at offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x1C
cofactor term d3 = v4*a1[4] - v6*a1[5] + v8*a1[6]; 3x3 minor for a1[3] using elements at offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18
return (d0*a1[0] - d1*a1[1] + d2*a1[2] - d3*a1[3]); signed cofactor expansion along column 0, reading first-column elements at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC; result widened to double
